claim: Exploratory trainability and causal-control pilot of the input-evoked CNS readout; no confirmatory or model-promotion claim.
notes: All choices fixed before pilot results. Fixed edges isolate the readout change. Same checkpoint, encoded row order, batch plan and trainable parameter initialization within a seed. Zero-edge control checks cancellation only. A matched dense-adapter capacity control, more seeds, longer training and fresh generation evaluation are required before confirmation. Existing v3 dev rows are reused for development; they are not an untouched final evaluation set. Never promote from this pilot.
